about: Permanently closed places. scripts/import_osm.py skips these OSM elements even while OSM still has them (fix OSM too); merge scripts never add them. Key = OSM ref, or 'name:<name>' when not in OSM.

way/626907760.name: Silver City
way/626907760.note: Chinese restaurant Silver City (Wondelgem, near Industrieweg) served its last meal on 17 Sep 2023. The owners called it a closure "for an indefinite period" and might restart later. No sign of reopening found. OSM address is Liefkensstraat; the article says Evergemsesteenweg near Industrieweg (same corner area).
way/626907760.certainty: less certain: the owners called it a closure "for an indefinite period" (Sep 2023) and might restart; no reopening found (Oct 2026)

node/10139555017.name: The Church
node/10139555017.note: Temporary summer pop-up bar at Oude Houtlei 56, which ran until 2 Oct 2021. No later activity found; the site belongs to Hotel Monasterium PoortAckere.

node/4107591327.name: Wijkrestaurant 't Oud Postje
node/4107591327.note: The landlord sogent says the neighbourhood restaurant was at Meulesteedsesteenweg 455 "until recently" (vond je tot voor kort). Search results report it closed in Feb 2023 and that the operator moved on to Café M at Meulesteedsesteenweg 515.
